cms_event.description: A node that is an event: one row, keyed by the node's id. Its dates are in cms_event_date.

id.description: The node that is the event.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone its dates are entered and shown in; empty: the site's (cms.event setting).

price.description: Displayed price, in units of the currency; zero is free, null unspecified. Not for checkout.

performer.description: Names of instructors, speakers or performers, comma-separated.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the event's language, independent of the page's.

external_link.description: HTTP(S) URL of an external event or registration page.

status.description: Empty while it takes place as planned; else cancelled, postponed or rescheduled (schema.org eventStatus).

online_url.description: HTTP(S) URL to take part online; with an address as well, it takes place both ways.

cms_event_date.description: The dates of an event: each a fixed interval with an inclusive start and exclusive end; equal ends are a moment.

start.description: Inclusive start in epoch seconds. Whole calendar days use UTC midnight coordinates with all_day set.

end.description: Exclusive end in epoch seconds. Whole calendar days use UTC midnight coordinates with all_day set.

all_day.description: True for whole calendar days; derived from date-only boundaries when written.

name.description: Optional name of this date within the event, such as a module of a course.

price.description: Displayed price of this date alone, in the event's currency; null: none of its own.
